_help: Every ad space on the site is a named slot below. Space is always reserved, so pages do not jump when an ad loads.

A slot shows, in this order: (1) a matching campaign, (2) a Google AdSense unit if adsense.enabled and the slot has an adsenseSlot id, (3) a house placeholder inviting advertisers (turn off with houseAds: false; the space stays reserved).
size: leaderboard = 728x90 on desktop and 320x100 on phones. rectangle = 300x250. anchor = 320x50 (sticky bar at the bottom of phones).

To sell a space: add an entry to campaigns with the slot ids it should appear in, then run the build. Campaigns outside start/end dates are skipped at build time, so redeploy daily (Cloudflare Pages deploy hook) if you run dated campaigns.
type 'image' needs image (and optionally imageMobile). type 'text' needs title, text, cta. type 'html' takes your own markup.
category 'political' adds a visible Political advertisement label with a Paid for by line. Check the rules that apply to election advertising before you sell these.
